owner_summaries.key_concerns: Control ownership gaps identified in TB balancing and FX coverage; insufficient accountability for flux analysis exceptions.

residual_risks.description: Entity-level TB balances are not zero, indicating potential misstatements in financial reporting.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Assign clear accountability for TB balancing and implement automated reconciliation tools.

residual_risks.description: FX rates coverage does not meet policy requirements, increasing exposure to currency risk.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Enhance FX rate validation processes and ensure policy adherence through periodic audits.

residual_risks.description: High flux analysis exception count (51) indicates potential anomalies in account balances.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Investigate root causes of flux exceptions and establish thresholds for acceptable variances.

residual_risks.description: One open HITL case may delay critical financial close processes.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Prioritize resolution of open HITL cases to avoid close delays.
